verse.verse_1: By the night as it envelops.
verse.verse_2: By the day as it appears.
verse.verse_3: By Him Who created male and female.
verse.verse_4: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse.
verse.verse_5: As for him who gives and has Taqwa,
verse.verse_7: We will make smooth for him the path of ease.
verse.verse_8: But he who is greedy and thinks himself self-sufficient,
verse.verse_10: We will make smooth for him the path to evil.
verse.verse_11: And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down (in destruction)
verse.verse_12: Truly, on Us is (to give) guidance.
verse.verse_13: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).
verse.verse_14: Therefore I have warned you of a Fire Talazza.
verse.verse_15: None shall enter it save the most wretched.
verse.verse_17: And those with Taqwa will be far removed from it.
verse.verse_18: He who gives of his wealth for self-purification.
verse.verse_19: And who has (in mind) no favor from anyone to be paid back.
verse.verse_20: Except to seek the Face of his Lord, the Most High.
